newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Baker to stay S.Australia Treasurer until election.
newsitem.headline: Baker to stay S.Australia Treasurer until election.

text.p: South Australian Treasurer Stephen Baker will remain in his portfolios until the forthcoming State election, despite announcing he intends to resign then, a government spokeswoman said on Monday.
Baker, who is also Minister for Mines and Energy, Housing and Urban Development, said in a surprise announcement on Sunday that he did not intend to contest the next State election.
He denied his decision was related to last year's ousting of former Premier Dean Brown, when Baker lost his position as deputy premier, saying it was "time for new challenges".
With Baker running the State's finances, South Australia raised A$1.7 billion from asset sales to tackle public debt following the disastrous A$3 billion collapse of the State Bank.

Premier John Olsen has said the next State election, which must be held by March 1998, is likely to be called for later this year, although there is continuing speculation that an announcement is imminent.
